summary: The candidate fixes the original valid Transformers-created DeepSeek V4 config failure and two earlier implementation defects, but its missing-compress-RoPE regression bypasses the real serialization/parser path. A config.json missing rope_parameters.compress is still accepted and silently receives Transformers defaults, so the claimed consolidated validation correction is incomplete.

tests.what_was_measured: The probe itself completed and captured the original engine configuration failure: SGLang loaded _DeepseekV4ConfigAlias and ModelConfig raised AttributeError because compress_ratios was absent. Evidence: /job/review-evidence/j-52d864784ab3/base-probe.json

Candidate regression suite: 12 tests and 4 subtests passed, including native registration and post-construction malformed-object validation. Evidence: /job/review-evidence/j-52d864784ab3/candidate-regression.log
The native Transformers DeepseekV4Config loaded exactly, and ModelConfig normalized the generated config to [128, 128, 128, 4]. Evidence: /job/review-evidence/j-52d864784ab3/candidate-probe.json

Five adversarial expectations passed, but a real serialized config missing rope_parameters.compress was accepted and defaulted instead of rejected. Evidence: /job/review-evidence/j-52d864784ab3/candidate-adversarial.json

gpu_execution.evidence: One AMD Instinct MI350X was visible with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, but no DeepSeek V4 weights were available. No GPU numerical or serving claim was made; /job/review-evidence/j-52d864784ab3/gpu-python.log records visibility only.

remaining_counterexamples: A serialized native DeepSeek V4 config.json with rope_parameters.main present but rope_parameters.compress absent is accepted. Transformers 5.12.1 inserts its default compress subsection before SGLang validation, so the omission is silently hidden rather than rejected.
remaining_limitations: No DeepSeek V4 weights were available, so full model loading, engine startup, GPU numerical accuracy, semantic behavior, and distributed serving remain unverified.
The pinned environment uses Transformers 5.12.1 rather than exactly 4.57.x; it exercises the newer native V4 schema relevant to the issue.
Fallback behavior on older Transformers versions without native DeepseekV4Config was source-reviewed but could not be executed without altering the pinned environment.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
